entries.scope: Embed the separately reviewed Secure Trader bundle transport in the existing sandbox image
entries.rationale: Maintainers must distinguish image build acceptance from explicit owner approval and operational activation.
entries.canonicalSource: home-baseline.lock.json for embedded source; published Home Baseline for transport; this image repository for build and runtime evidence
entries.navigationImpact: Extend the existing operations validation page with the dated image-pin session evidence.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and equivalent English second, around CEFR B2.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: After an initial ENOSPC failure and separately authorized reference-checked image cleanup, the native ARM64 standard build, CycloneDX SBOM, non-root immutable-reference/package proof and isolated full toolchain/documentation smoke passed. Exact image and SBOM hashes are in the session evidence. No operational activation, PDF accessibility acceptance, live model inference or other native platform acceptance is claimed.
entries.risk: Confusing a built image with an approved operational sandbox could bypass the exact-image and package decision. Approval remains pending until the owner explicitly decides.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Any source pin, actual image, package fingerprint, mount, credential boundary or expiry change.
